blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—National University strengthened its bid for a twice-to-beat advantage after edging La Salle, 84-80, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Araneta Coliseum. The Bulldogs improved to 8-3 and tightened their hold on the second seed. They sit just a game behind league leader University of the Philippines, which holds a 9-2 record after defeating Ateneo on Saturday. “They just didn’t give up in the end even if La Salle was getting their momentum in the crucial ending of that fourth quarter,” coach Jeff Napa said. “Somehow, […]...
